verdict.rationale: A probe confirms a live llms.txt at docs.telli.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200, with a proper header and summary). The docs are also served as Markdown pages (.md URLs), and the vendor explicitly offers a downloadable OpenAPI spec to 'give coding agents machine-readable API context', which is also probed live. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of an agent actually consuming these docs effectively, and no evidence of an expanded llms-full.txt variant.
